title: Story premise EDU084: The Motion Dial Keeps the Meaning
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: Can this screen explain the change without the swoop? Takeaway/theme: Motion can be optional while the underlying information and control remain available.
description: A viewer wants the result of an interface action, but a long sweeping animation is uncomfortable or distracting. A reduced-motion version preserves the state change with a quieter transition and equivalent information.
